description:
Technical Skill :- 
 Java Developer with 8+ years of MEAN stack (Mongo, Express, Angular JS, Node development experience in the field of Software Engineering and Development. 

 Minimum 3+ years of hands-on development experience with Mongo, Express, node.js, Angular JS, JQuery, NoSQL and scalable web
 Good exposure to designing, building and deploying REST/JSON based APIs using Java/Node.JS based frameworks.
 Strong understanding of design patterns and best practices in Java/J2EE platform including UI, Application & Frameworks development.
 Good exposure to designing, building and deploying REST/JSON based APIs using Java/Node.JS based frameworks.
 Managed architectures and design deliverables for high performance and internet scale systems
 Must be a strong team player with good leadership skills
 Effective communicator within and across teams
 Experience in enterprise systems like SalesForce, Siebel, Oracle is a big plus.


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 12+ Months 
 Candidate must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
